description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 07.12.2020 to 13.12.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and explicitly rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it names an individual (the Director General), this is in an official capacity to establish legal authority, and the core content is purely regulatory without any government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
